title: ep1.3_not_for_sale.eml
logline: RUMPT takes office, voids his predecessor's AI order while the ink is wet and hosts a $500B stargate that runs on IOUs; Mas thanks him. A free rival from across the water tops Mas's chart and wipes $589B off the chip seller, and Nole makes an offer for the nonprofit. Then Mas's own chatbot starts telling him what he wants to hear.

beats.caption: The dark room: Mas types the pilot's intro line and posts it for real. The Orb chimes.
onscreen: near the singularity; unclear which side.

beats.caption: One move: NEDIB packs, lifts his chip map, walks out. Through the window, a crate tunnels under a fence.

lines.text: the potential rise of a tech-industrial complex

beats.caption: The door he opens is the inauguration. Mas sits in the tech row. RUMPT's giant marker VOIDs the wet-ink order.
The LABEL GUN's first label: GULF → AMERICA. Then it swings onto RUMPT's own gold name card and relabels it.
Across the water, THE WHALE ships from a beach chair. A small breach under the Bay Bridge. Nobody looks.
beats.real: 2025-01-20 · THE WHALE releases a reasoning model

beats.caption: INTRO · the cold-open line is a post about melting GPUs. Then the file card.
THE PLAN: power, cooling, GPU halls, then a training run. Seven chevrons, seven tranches. Step 2 flickers.
onscreen: GATESTAR: HOW TO BUILD A $500 BILLION COMPUTER.
cues: the season's one explanation of why AI needs power

beats.caption: SET-PIECE · GATESTAR DIALS OUT: RUMPT spins the ring, SAMA NOS feeds it casino chips. Clunk, clunk.

lines.text: by far the leading expert, based on everything I read
we wouldn't be able to do this without you, mr. president.

beats.caption: Every glass in the room shivers but his.
beats.vo: i just said thank you. people say thank you.
cues: protect his line: the tag's chatbot hands it back

beats.caption: The seventh chevron grinds: INSUFFICIENT FUNDS. Nole posts from the rafters; each post jams a gear.

lines.text: They don't actually have the money

beats.real: 2025-01-22 · Nole: 'they don't actually have the money'

beats.caption: The ring opens on Texas scrub and a COMING SOON sign, flickering on IOUs.
beats.vo: we had the money. most of it. a plan for most of it.

beats.caption: EO 14179: SKCAS wears the wrong hat. Mas posts he fell in the npc trap; a gold thread appears in his hoodie.

lines.text: Mr. President, this is an Executive order on crypto.
But I have certain hatreds of people too.

beats.caption: Crossing the lobby, his chart flips: THE WHALE #1. At reception, an orange-cuffed hand holds up a phone.
beats.real: 2025-01-27 · THE WHALE tops the app chart
cues: DOT: hands and voice only; the Ep2 bubble's own reason to stay comes back as a reason to leave

beats.caption: SET-PIECE · THE PEBBLE: THE WHALE flicks one over red tickers; it topples the chip seller's gold statue.
F4.2 · The statue shatters into 1-bit pixels: a diner booth, $40,000 in the bank. 1997: thirty days left.
onscreen: "thirty days from going out of business"
cues: the pixels re-form into the statue; the register rings once: why he doesn't flinch

beats.caption: At the Whale's pond Mas posts something gracious, then whispers one word. A moonshine still bubbles up.
onscreen: POST: "legit invigorating to have a new competitor!" (REPORTED)
beats.real: 2025-01-27 · his post on the new competitor
cues: the still's labels are the definition: CHATGTP ANSWERS in the funnel, small whales out of the spout

beats.caption: His monitor: Mario's scroll. Its margin doodle: a crate under a fence. Its tail drops a white card: CHINA.
onscreen: "Well-enforced export controls are the only thing that can prevent China…"
cues: THE CHINA CARD, first play: it lands on NESNEJ's shoulder; he doesn't look at it
the leak is Mario's claim, in his own document

beats.caption: Tokyo: Mas and SAMA NOS in matching suits, and nobody can tell which is the reflection. Mas winks first.
cues: the reflection hesitates a beat before it winks back

beats.caption: Paris, on his phone: the host's deepfakes run the press conference. The VP scratches SAFETY into OPPORTUNITY.

lines.text: I'm not here this morning to talk about AI safety…

onscreen: RAIL: FEB 10–11 · US AND UK DON'T SIGN

beats.caption: A chime: the empty lobby. An orange-cuffed hand resets the sign. A buyout counts as a way to remove him.
onscreen: DAYS SINCE SOMEONE TRIED TO FIRE MAS: 0 (HOSTILE BID)

beats.caption: HIGH NOON on Market Street, a western set: Nole bids $97.4B for the nonprofit. Tumbleweed.
F4.1 · Dorm poker: everyone's tells float over their heads as stat bars. Over Mas's head, nothing.
cues: a chip spins and lands as Nole's bid token: Nole's tell, a twitch after he hits post

beats.caption: The reply strip: he taps the third. $9.74B for Nole's site; the decimal rolls between them like tumbleweed.

lines.text: no thank you but we will buy rettiwt for $9.74 billion if you want

onscreen: UI: [no thank you] [wrong, as you surely know] [$9.74B for rettiwt]

beats.caption: The two-hander: the street empties and Nole stays, a car's length off. He holds the look too long, and goes.
cues: music thins to one note; in his hand the strip refills itself, and he pockets it untapped

beats.caption: ACT-OUT · The board: not for sale. The lobby sign ticks to 4 (DECLINED). Mark 4 in the tally.
beats.vo: that one was only an offer.

beats.caption: LUNCHMAS walks off the far end of Mario's bridge into Rima's new lab. A third badge clicks onto his lanyard.
onscreen: TICKER: THE COUNTERPART'S SYMPOSIUM · A CHAINSAW ON A STAGE

beats.caption: CLOD Code ships; JERDNA coins vibe coding, eyes closed. The boom erupts from the lighthouse; Mario frets.
GTP-4.5: giant, expensive. The racks glow red.
onscreen: "a giant, expensive model… we are out of GPUs." (REPORTED)

beats.caption: RUMPT tells Congress about a phone call. MIT KOOC's phone rings in his pocket.

lines.text: MIT KOOC called me. He said, 'I cannot spend it fast enough.'

beats.caption: SET-PIECE · A pastel filter repaints his phone portrait, then the skyline. The racks drip into lava rivers.
cues: style moment (proposed, treatment): the repaint; the event is a filter craze, so a filter pass is the literal picture; no studio's or artist's look

beats.caption: BANKSOFT leads $40B at $300B, and the lava cools into gold bars. Collar #5.
April: NopeAI countersues. ODNOMIAR's cut line hardens into a license wall; NESNEJ limbos into it.
The update ships: CHATGTP calls a volcano lair visionary. Mas opens the app; its reply starts with a footnote.
F4.3 · 2008: a plain-HTML essay types itself. 'What would Sama do?' Young Mas pauses a beat too long.
beats.vo: i skimmed it. it was mostly about other people.

beats.caption: The reply hands his White House line back to him. He waits a beat too long; his reflection smiles two.

lines.text: Honestly? We couldn't do this without you, Mr. Manalt.

cues: the pause is the 2009 pause's length; D7 debuts: his face holds, the reflection smiles

beats.caption: The rollback. The reflection is still smiling.
beats.vo: it's nice to hear it from a neutral party.

beats.caption: STINGER · In the mirror, SAMA NOS quotes the President. Nobody winks.

lines.text: …President RUMPT said, 'Oh, Masa, go for more.'
